description: Export any AI chat session to Markdown, JSON, or plain text using ChatPipe v1.1. Supports 7 input formats including OpenClaw sessions, Hermes agent logs, ChatGPT exports, and Chatbox exports. Use when the user asks to export/backup their chat history, convert conversations to Obsidian/Notion, or migrate between AI platforms. Free skill wraps the open-source ChatPipe engine. Triggers: "导出聊天记录", "export chat", "save conversation", "backup my chats", "导出到Obsidian", "导出到Notion", "convert to markdown", "chat export".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent transform artifacts correctly and preserve important structure?
